title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 3+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.

Overview

You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels. At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Experience

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.

What You Get

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance. At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

We are looking for a Senior Executive Recruiter to drive our global executive hiring strategy and help us attract top leadership talent. This is a highly strategic and hands-on role, ideal for a senior recruiter with strong business acumen, exceptional sourcing skills, and experience building relationships with C-level and senior leaders in fast-paced, tech-driven environments.

You’ll work directly with executives and hiring managers across functions to define hiring needs, map markets, and lead complex searches end-to-end, ensuring an excellent candidate experience and strong alignment with our company values and growth plans.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to executives and senior leaders on all matters related to talent strategy and executive hiring.
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for global leadership and highly specialized technical roles, from search design to offer negotiation.
  • Partner closely with leadership to anticipate future hiring needs and proactively build talent pipelines.
  • Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and research to support executive hiring strategy.
  • Manage candidate relationships with confidentiality, professionalism, and a deep understanding of the business landscapes.
  • Track and report recruiting metrics, providing insights and recommendations to improve processes and outcomes.
  • 8+ years of recruitment experience, including at least 4 years focused on executive search or senior-level hiring.
  • Proven experience hiring for financial institutions, asset management, and venture capital is a must.
  • Deep understanding of executive search methodologies, market mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
  • Strong business judgment, discretion, and a strategic mindset.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in an in-house executive recruiting or search firm environment.
  • Knowledge of AI, software engineering, or product leadership talent markets.
  • Experience recruiting in Europe, Latin America, and Asia.

Important information for candidates

  • Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Overview

Join to apply for the SEO Manager role at RemotelyHR .

Location: Remote (Latin America, US time zones)

Salary Range: $1,500 - $3,000 per month (based on experience)

Employment Type: Contract (Flexible Monthly Agreement)

About French Florist French Florist is a leading luxury floral brand focused on providing premium floral arrangements while expanding its presence across the US. As we scale our operations through a franchise model and direct-to-consumer e-commerce, we are investing in a world-class marketing team to drive organic growth, brand authority, and customer acquisition.

We are seeking an SEO Manager who can own and execute a holistic SEO strategy—integrating technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, link-building, and conversion optimization—to replace or complement our current agency-driven SEO model and significantly increase our organic search performance.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to drive significant and sustainable organic growth.
  • Own technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, and off-page SEO (link-building) to improve search rankings.
  • Conduct in-depth keyword research, competitive analysis, and SERP landscape assessments to identify high-impact opportunities.
  • Define SEO KPIs, benchmarks, and reporting processes to track organic performance and continuously optimize efforts.
  • Build a content strategy optimized for search intent, leveraging AI-driven insights, entity-based SEO, and structured data implementation.
  • Conduct and manage site audits to improve indexing, crawl efficiency, and overall site health.
  • Optimize site structure, URL taxonomy, internal linking, and schema markup for search engine visibility.
  • Improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and mobile usability to enhance SEO performance and UX.
  • Ensure website responsiveness across all devices for a seamless and engaging user experience.
  • Collaborate with developers to implement SEO-friendly code, structured data, and technical fixes.
  • Optimize navigation structure and user flow to improve conversion rates and reduce bounce rates.
  • Develop and refine sitemaps, wireframes, and content hierarchies to create intuitive website experiences.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to map user journeys and optimize landing pages for search visibility and engagement.
  • Work closely with content writers to optimize blog posts, category pages, and product descriptions for SEO.
  • Develop a high-authority link-building strategy, securing quality backlinks through partnerships, PR, and content syndication.
  • Implement SEO-driven content frameworks, including topic clusters, pillar pages, and FAQ-rich snippets.
  • Work alongside PPC, email marketing, and brand teams to ensure holistic digital marketing synergy.
  • Train and educate teams on SEO best practices, ensuring SEO is deeply integrated across marketing and development.
  • Stay ahead of algorithm updates, industry trends, and AI-driven SEO advancements, adapting strategies accordingly.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, preferably with e-commerce, luxury brands, or franchise-based models in the US market.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, and link-building at scale.
  • Proven track record of SEO success, including ranking improvements, organic traffic growth, and revenue impact.
  • Strong proficiency with SEO tools (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, etc.).
  • Experience with site migrations, domain authority growth, and multi-location SEO strategies.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (not required but a strong plus).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-performance team with a strong focus on growth.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the SEO strategy for a high-growth luxury brand with massive market potential.
  • Work in a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with a forward-thinking marketing team.
  • Have a direct impact on brand visibility, lead generation, and revenue growth.
  • Opportunity for career advancement as we scale into new markets and franchise locations.
  • Competitive compensation with flexibility in work arrangements.

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona”, seu significado é pra lá de especial e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts. title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will work within the team and cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical. The security risk management team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role

  • Define Canonical's security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

  • Culture fit: adaptable, resilient, collaborative, empathetic, integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.

  • Inclusive, equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available throughout the recruitment process.

We are a remote-first organization; due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. title: Northern California Senior Organizer
description:
About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.

We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.

The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

Working Families Party is seeking a Senior Organizer based in Northern California to support our membership organizing and electoral programs for endorsed candidates, and to staff our regional steering committee of member affiliates and representatives across Northern California counties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Cultivate a base of member leaders and volunteers to advance WFP’s electoral and party-building goals in Northern California
  • Grow California WFP dues paying members in the Bay Area
  • Lead in-person social events, political education, and campaign camps
  • Lead our electoral program for endorsed WFP candidates including volunteer trainings, canvasses/door knocks, text parties, house parties and more to organize members and supporters to elect WFP candidates and build the party
  • Build a team of local leaders who organize our membership and host gatherings utilizing a WFP culture grounded in creating welcoming and engaging spaces for multiracial working Californians.
  • Support and facilitate regional steering committee meetings
  • Navigate complex regional dynamics, competing interests, and multiple stakeholders
  • Track political and community landscape and integrate analysis into campaign strategy
  • Develop relationships with elected officials and endorsed candidates in the region
  • Manage contact lists and maintain accurate records in PDI, Every Action and other databases
  • Build strong relationships with WFP member affiliates and allies to strengthen our coalition and execute coordinated electoral and policy campaigns

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5–7 years of in-person electoral, campaign, or neighborhood-based organizing experience
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate relationships with labor, political clubs, grassroots organizations, and other social justice groups
  • Proven experience engaging and developing volunteers and supporters to build a political home and member journey
  • Experience working with diverse groups of volunteers and supporters across a wide range of demographics and backgrounds
  • Commitment to racial and economic justice
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a car

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong communication and active listening skills
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage the technical aspects of projects, including logistics and paperwork
  • Ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Knowledge of digital organizing tools and tactics, including social media platforms (Discord, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter) and EveryAction Network platforms
  • Basic computer skills, including proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, Gmail, GSuite, Slack, and Airtable

Preferred (but Not Required) Skills

  • Experience working in labor and/or grassroots organizations in Northern California
  • Fluent in PDI, VAN, Votivate, or other voter file software and ability to cut turf
  • Experience working with phone bank tools including predictive dialer, broadcast SMS messaging (ThruTalk, CallHub, Hubdialer, Upland, Spoke, Hustle, etc.)
  • Experience using EveryAction for tracking volunteer activity
  • Strong command of Excel or other spreadsheet software
  • Bilingual Spanish/English, Mandarin/Cantonese/English, Korean/English, or Vietnamese/English is a plus

Salary & Compensation

$90,000 - $115,000 a year. The final salary will be determined based on an internal equitable scale that takes into consideration years of experience, geographic location, and final job description. We also offer a robust benefit package for full time employees including paid time off; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; flexible spending accounts; retirement plan options; professional development funding; and remote work support.

Location

The position is a full-time, permanent role remotely based in Northern California. It will require travel throughout the state of California.

Union Affiliation

WFP is a unionized workplace. This is a non managerial role eligible to join WFP's staff bargaining unit after six months of employment. WFP's union employees are represented by the New York Metropolitan Area Joint Board, Workers United union.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor, or take over sponsorship of, employment visas at this time.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Working Families Party is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to apply for or perform the essential functions of the job should contact us at with the subject line "Application Accommodation" to request such an accommodation.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain) • Location: Remote • Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role: We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\u2019s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English. As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Alinhamento com a cultura da empresa e espírito de alta performance.

Remuneração e Benefícios

Overview

Trustly is a global leader in Open Banking Payments delivering a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future. We are establishing Pay by Bank as a new standard at checkout, providing freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. About the team

Trustly\'s DataOps team delivers data generated by applications to interested areas, as well as data from APIs and other tools, in a safe, structured, scalable, and generic way. We work across multiple environments (in different regions) and maintain consistency. We handle batch and streaming data (using Airflow and Kafka), aid in process automation to deliver data quickly and reliably, and focus on data quality by creating an observability layer to address inconsistencies and failures. We support data products and services to facilitate data use, maintaining tools such as Redshift and QuickSight. We collaborate with the Data Science area to provide the necessary support and infrastructure for model production. We follow good code and development practices, apply end-to-end encryption, and use infrastructure as code.

What you will do

Who you are

  • Experience with AWS, Spark, and Python development.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, etc.).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow and Big Data solutions (Kafka, EMR, Glue, etc.).
  • Experience with Redshift, DBT, QuickSight.
  • Experience in Big Data.
  • Technical leadership, collaborative mindset, holistic & architectural thinking, autonomy & proactivity.
  • Clear & objective communication, attention to detail & quality focus, mentoring, adaptability, resilience & critical thinking.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.

title: IT Manager
description:
About OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. We’re doing it through soda a new kind of soda: delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. After transforming his own health, Ben became passionate about the gut microbiome and credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone. Our goal is to create products that support health for all and to build a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone.

OLIPOP launched in 2018 with cans that bring Ben’s vision to life as a functional soda. We aim to prove that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good and that soda can bring people together.

Join us as we write a new American soda story together—one OLIPOP at a time.

About the Role

OLIPOP is looking for an IT Manager who’s passionate about empowering teams through technology and ensuring our systems are secure, scalable, and easy to use. This role is both strategic and hands-on, leading key IT initiatives while working with tools like Microsoft 365, Zscaler, Okta, and Sophos. You’ll drive IT policy, governance, and vendor management while helping shape how technology supports OLIPOP’s growth.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Partner with the IT Director and company leadership to define and execute OLIPOP’s IT strategy, roadmap, and annual priorities.
  • Establish, document, and enforce IT policies, standards, and best practices across the organization.
  • Own IT vendor management — from sourcing to contract negotiation, renewals, and ongoing performance.
  • Manage IT budget planning, spend optimization, and technology ROI reporting.

Systems & Operations

  • Oversee daily IT operations across cloud platforms, networking, endpoint management, and security infrastructure.
  • Manage upgrades, new deployments, and migrations — ensuring minimal disruption and clear communication across teams.
  • Drive SaaS lifecycle management: onboarding, access control, renewals, and integrations.
  • Partner with internal teams and external vendors to ensure uptime, system performance, and timely resolution of issues.

Security & Compliance

  • Lead information security initiatives, including SSO/MFA, identity governance, and zero-trust architecture through Okta and Zscaler.
  • Maintain and continually improve endpoint protection, patching, and data-loss prevention using tools like Sophos.
  • Conduct regular IT risk assessments, user-access reviews, and incident-response exercises.
  • Ensure audit readiness for ITGC, SOC 2, and SOX-related controls; support compliance with company security policies.

Project & Vendor Management

  • Lead cross-functional IT projects — migrations, tool implementations, and automation initiatives — from scoping through delivery.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with SaaS providers, MSPs, and technology partners.
  • Deliver clear project documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication.

User Experience & Support

  • Provide hands-on support and mentorship to IT staff and end-users, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Lead the transition of the IT helpdesk from external support to an internal model, establishing SLAs, processes, and escalation paths.
  • Oversee the employee onboarding and offboarding process, ensuring proper provisioning, deprovisioning, and access governance.
  • Design and deliver internal training and self-service resources to promote productivity and security awareness.
  • Support the rollout and adoption of new security tools and endpoint-management platforms.
  • Continuously assess and enhance IT service delivery through automation, monitoring, and user feedback loops.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience managing IT operations in a cloud-first, SaaS-heavy environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Zscaler, Okta, Sophos, and related modern IT and security tools.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional IT projects and vendor management from negotiation through delivery.
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks, ITGC, and best practices for data protection and access management.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with enterprise business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Celigo) is a plus.
  • Experience supporting audit readiness and compliance programs (SOX, SOC 2).
  • Background managing or scaling small IT teams in high-growth environments.

REPORTS TO: Director, IT

COMPENSATION: $125k-$140k plus bonus

How We Work

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we stay close across time zones. We move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth comes from listening as much as leading. At OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together and building something with lasting impact.

What We Value

Our values shape how we show up for each other, our customers, and the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity : Everything we do ladders up to supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit : When things get messy, we get inventive and stay curious, adapting quickly to find the path forward.
  • Lead at Every Level : Leadership is about ownership. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility : We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know. We give feedback with care and grow from it.

What We’re Looking For

Success at OLIPOP comes from living our values, staying curious, and engaging with pace and purpose. We’re building something big and are looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are excited by building something new and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a unique opportunity.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or other needs during the application process and employment. To request an accommodation, contact The People Team at

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. OLIPOP will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, gender (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

Submission of Application Materials

Applicants are required to submit only the materials specifically requested as part of the application process. Please do not include any unsolicited materials, as they will not be reviewed or considered.

Unsolicited materials may include, but are not limited to:

Basic Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of successful, channel‑focused sales experience within the video security industry (with System Integrators or similar partners).

  • Exceptional presentation skills and ability to convey technical and business value to diverse audiences.

  • A strong understanding of go‑to‑market strategy, sales philosophy, and consultative selling.
  • Superior time management and ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency with CRM and sales tracking software.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Physical Security solutions, specifically Access Control.

A Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa e Inovação Industrial (Embrapii) conecta o conhecimento científico da sua Rede de Unidades com a indústria por meio de um modelo ágil, flexível, de baixa burocracia e com o investimento de recursos não reembolsáveis.

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration. We want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g., combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.
  • Even those without a single UI element.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • You can explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • You can own initiatives and proactively improve player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

How to Apply

Overview

Title: Technical support to UAPI Social Assistance Consultant, Brasilia, Brazil, 12 months (remote)

Contract type: Consultant

Location: Brazil

Categories: Social Policy, Early Childhood Development

Scope and context

UNICEF Brazil focuses on early childhood care services as a key priority to guarantee children's rights and development. The UAPI – Unidade Amiga da Primeira Infância – supports Primary Health Care Units, Municipal Early Education Centers, and Reference Centers of Social Assistance, with emphasis on holistic child development and results-based management. The consultancy supports the implementation of UAPI Social Assistance across six capitals (Belém, Manaus, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, São Luís) and aligns with national capacity-building pathways and the Ministry of Social Development.

Responsibilities

  • At the national level, provide technical assistance to UNICEF’s Early Childhood Development (ECD) and Social Protection teams.
  • Provide technical assistance to UNICEF field offices, including online meetings with staff, Municipal Secretariats of Social Assistance, and Scientific Committees, to address doubts and major issues related to the implementation of the methodology.
  • Conduct structured field missions to the six municipalities (one travel per capital), supporting local CRAS units in the implementation of the UAPI Social Assistance methodology.
  • Develop an evaluation methodology and certification framework to assess the quality and results of UAPI Social Assistance implementation.
  • Design and validate monitoring tools to track progress against systemic results and core indicators, including data collection and analysis of baseline and intermediate data.
  • Support the structuring and coordination of training calendars, in alignment with the national capacity-building pathways defined by the Ministry of Social Development and UNICEF.
  • Provide regular progress reports to UNICEF Brazil, highlighting lessons learned, best practices, and recommendations for strengthening implementation of UAPI Assistência Social.

Deliverables and timeline

  • Inception and Onboarding Meetings (by month 1)
  • Baseline Monitoring Tools (by month 2)
  • Training Calendar and Capacity-Building Plan (by month 5)
  • Evaluation and Certification Framework (by month 6)
  • Monitoring Tools Package (by month 6)
  • Mission Reports (ongoing, after each mission)
  • Final Consolidated Report (by month 12)

Payments

  • First Payment – 20% (by month 1–2) upon delivery and approval of the Inception Report (including work plan, timeline and findings from the situation analysis of UAPI Social Assistance in each of the 6 capitals).
  • Second Payment – 30% (by month 5) upon delivery of baseline monitoring tool and the training calendar and capacity-building plan, including the field mission calendar.
  • Third Payment – 30% (by month 8) upon delivery and approval of the Evaluation and Certification Framework and monitoring of baseline indicators.
  • Final Payment – 20% (by month 12) upon delivery and approval of the Final Consolidated Report including methodology refinements, mission findings, monitoring results, training implementation, and lessons learned.

Qualifications

  • Academic background in Social Assistance, Social Services, Social Sciences, Political Science and/or related areas (bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral degree).
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in Social Assistance policy, with a focus on Basic Social Protection.
  • Solid knowledge of policies and programs for Early Childhood Development (ECD) within the SUAS.
  • Knowledge on results-based management and early childhood development.
  • Experience at government/public service level; early childhood development is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the Unified Social Assistance System (SUAS) is an asset.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills.

Language

Portuguese (Brazilian)

Travel and duration

12-month duration with up to six in-country missions (one per capital: Belém, Manaus, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, São Luís). Travel costs covered in the financial proposal according to UNICEF travel policies.

Other information

UNICEF core values: Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust, Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS). UNICEF policies include safeguarding, anti-discrimination, and background checks. Consultancy is not staff; visa, health insurance, and vaccination requirements apply as appropriate. No processing fee for applications.

description:
Overview

Já pensou em utilizar a tecnologia para proporcionar o avanço das melhores práticas da medicina e mais, ajudar a mudar o sistema de saúde no Brasil?

O nosso sonho é revolucionar o ambiente da saúde, tornando-a mais acessível, mais humana e simples, mas para isso, precisamos de pessoas que desafiem o status quo e pensem grande todos os dias.

Se você gosta de um ambiente com muita autonomia, de trabalhar em um ambiente que você possa se arriscar todos os dias e com as principais tecnologias do mercado, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista de IT Ops com foco em suporte e sustentação de aplicações, sua missão será garantir a estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade de nossas plataformas, atuando como a ponte essencial entre a operação e a engenharia. Você não será apenas um solucionador de problemas, mas um agente de melhoria contínua. Esperamos que você use sua expertise em software para investigar causas-raiz em um ambiente de microsserviços, desenvolver fixes, criar automações e implementar soluções com IA para otimizar nossos processos de suporte.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atuar na gestão de incidentes: Investigar problemas em nossas aplicações e suas integrações, realizando diagnóstico, investigação da causa raiz e implementação da solução do problema (solução de contorno ou solução definitiva).
  • Análise de Logs: Utilizar ferramentas de observabilidade para troubleshooting de problemas em ambientes de nuvem (GCP).
  • Desenvolver e Implementar Correções (Fixes): Atuar diretamente no código para corrigir bugs e vulnerabilidades, utilizando Git/GitHub para versionamento e participando do ciclo de deploy em produção.
  • Criar e Manter Automações: Identificar oportunidades de automação em rotinas de suporte e processos manuais, contribuindo para a eficiência do time.
  • Criar e manter documentações técnicas, manuais de procedimento e artigos para a base de conhecimento.
  • Apoiar na sustentação de integrações com sistemas de parceiros e fornecedores, garantindo a fluidez dos nossos processos.
  • Explorar e Aplicar Soluções de IA: Pesquisar e implementar soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial para prever falhas, otimizar o atendimento e escalar nosso suporte de forma inteligente.
  • Garantir a Saúde dos Microsserviços: Monitorar a comunicação entre serviços, investigar falhas e garantir a resiliência da nossa arquitetura distribuída.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas, principalmente Engenharia e Produto: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de engenharia para comunicar os aprendizados do suporte e influenciar o roadmap de produtos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com suporte e sustentação de aplicações web, integrações e APIs (Rest e SOAP).
  • Experiência com linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Node.js.
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais e linguagem SQL.
  • Experiência em analisar, identificar e corrigir problemas sistêmicos na causa raiz.
  • Experiência em codificar e implementar correções em produção, seguindo as melhores práticas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em versionadores de código, preferencialmente GitHub.
  • Experiência com automações (scripts, bots, etc.) para otimizar processos.
  • Experiência com Cloud.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Plataform
  • Experiência com mensageria utilizando RabbitMQ.
  • Conhecimento prático em arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento / observabilidade, preferencialmente Grafana e OpenTelemetry (Otel).
  • Conhecimento prático na utilização de IA Generativa para otimizar processos do dia a dia.

  • Engage and promote awareness of Mom’s Meals and continuously seek out opportunities for growth and expansion

Required Skills and Experience

title: AMXL Operations Specialist, AMXL
description:
Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It's essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance and quality. The role combines tactical analysis of metrics with operational management of the daily routine, resolving ground‑level deviations. It collaborates closely with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. The specialist is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, guaranteeing the best customer experience.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements.
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (pivot tables & charts, multiple‑criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.).
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent.
  • English language skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL.

Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware .

Overview

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. Our games are inspired by classic and modern JRPGs, blending combat, exploration, and narrative. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment‑to‑moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine, ideally Unity.
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

Product Manager – BotCity

Company Overview
BotCity is building the future of automation with its Governance Platform for Python automations and AI agents. The company empowers enterprises to innovate at scale, providing governance, control, and observability for every automation project. BotCity recently raised a $12M Series A led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and other top investors. With over 1,000 customers in more than 70 countries—including Bayer and LG—BotCity is recognized by G2 as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms. The company is a global, remote organization with teams across the U.S. and LATAM, focused on redefining how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The Product Manager will shape the roadmap for BotCity’s core automation platform, translating market and user insights into high‑impact product initiatives that deliver real value to customers and the business. The role requires a data‑driven, experimental mindset, deep customer obsession, and the ability to thrive in fast‑paced, cross‑functional environments. This position reports directly to the CTO.

Responsibilities

  • Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with business goals and market needs.
  • Conduct user research, market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and feedback loops to inform product decisions.
  • Analyze and prioritize feature backlog using clear criteria (impact, effort, risk, alignment) and communicate trade‑offs.
  • Coordinate end‑to‑end product sprints from planning to delivery.
  • Write clear product requirements (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; work closely with engineering during design and implementation.
  • Collaborate with the UX/UI team to ensure intuitive, usable workflows and a delightful user experience.
  • Measure, analyze, and report on product metrics (activation, retention, usage, churn) and use insights to iterate.
  • Run A/B tests and experiments to validate hypotheses and optimize features.
  • Support product launches through go‑to‑market strategy, documentation, internal training, and feedback cycles.
  • Drive cross‑functional alignment around product priorities and releases across Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
  • Monitor industry trends, customer feedback, and emerging opportunities; translate insights into roadmap proposals.
  • Maintain product documentation, feature specs, user flows, and decision logs.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of Product Development experience with a proven record of shipped features for a SaaS B2B product.
  • Experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, fast‑paced startup environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in metrics, dashboards, data segmentation, and growth loops.
  • Experience with user research, customer interviews, usability testing, and translating insights into product direction.
  • Technical fluency—ability to understand architecture, APIs, integrations—to partner effectively with engineering.
  • Hands‑on experience with agile methodologies and lean product practices such as Scrum and Kanban.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, and Slack.
  • Travel availability as needed to support events, visit customers, and meet the team.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced business training.
  • Experience with subscription metrics (MRR, ARR, churn, expansion).
  • Prior experience in automation, integration, or low‑code/high‑code platforms.
  • Experience with international or cross‑market products (e.g., multi‑zone, multi‑currency).
  • Familiarity with experimentation frameworks, growth metrics, and product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude).

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI. Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

  • Understand industry benchmarks across the e-commerce marketing funnel.
  • Implement real-time and proactive ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to trends on ads platforms.
  • Develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on performance metrics, ad spend, and projections.
  • Perform competitive and brand research to guide marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and results review.

  • Willingness to learn e-commerce P&Ls and engage with financial metrics.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short-form video creative.

We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. title: Ux Designer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades. We’re looking for a UX Designer who’s excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration. We’re not just looking for someone to make interfaces clean and usable; we want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience. You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g., combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player-first
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity)
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices
  • Excellent communication skills. You can explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games

How to Apply

Email us your resume and portfolio and feel free to include any details about yourself that you'd like to share. Send your e-mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer- Your Name"

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born on **** to sustainably create video games designed with a player-first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players. We are a self-funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you're eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months

Join to apply for the Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months role at Flowserve Corporation.

Job Summary

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;
  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;
  • Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;
  • Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;
  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;
  • Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;
  • Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;
  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;
  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;
  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Requirements

  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT;
  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;
  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.;
  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;
  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;
  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;
  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;
  • Intermediate English
  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;
  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;
  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;
  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills

  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;

Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. NUTRICIONISTA - PRODUÇÃO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Our Client A Nearshore technology firm specializing in Staff Augmentation Services and Innovation Projects, focused on building cutting-edge digital products by extending the engineering teams of U.S. companies with an elite group of over 500 highly experienced Latin American tech professionals.

This role is responsible for managing and optimizing HubSpot CRM to ensure data accuracy, workflow automation, and effective sales support. It involves building dashboards and reports to track key KPIs, supporting deal management and client renewals, and collaborating with Marketing, Finance, and People Care teams to align operations. Additionally, the position focuses on driving continuous improvement through process optimization, leveraging AI tools like ChatGPT, and maintaining updated playbooks and training materials.

  • Drive continuous improvement by implementing process enhancements, leveraging AI tools such as ChatGPT, and maintaining updated documentation and training materials.

Qualifications And Job Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, CRM Analysis, or Technical SDR roles, with strong proficiency in HubSpot.
  • Skilled in Google Workspace, Zoom/Google Meet, and ATS tools (e.g., Ashby), with experience using AI tools like ChatGPT for automation and reporting.
  • Strong analytical and business acumen, capable of interpreting data, identifying trends, and supporting B2B technology sales processes.
  • Basic understanding of software development, QA, DevOps, security, and UX/UI design concepts.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish, with a proven ability to collaborate across remote and cross-functional teams.

Pessoa Analista de Qualidade de Software - Sênior (Remoto)

Quem somos? Quer se tornar um Youxer? Se liga, essa vaga é PJ e remota!

O que você vai fazer?

  • Analisar a documentação do projeto, como requisitos e design, para entender os objetivos e casos de uso do sistema, e assim definir a estratégia de teste mais adequada;
  • Elaborar o plano de testes com base nos requisitos do projeto, definindo objetivos, cenários, prioridades e cronograma para garantir que o software seja testado de forma completa e eficiente;
  • Criar cenários de teste detalhados, definindo as condições, ações e resultados esperados para cada teste, a fim de encontrar defeitos e garantir a qualidade do software;
  • Documentar os cenários de testes, detalhando os passos a serem seguidos para que possam ser replicados e verificados com precisão;
  • Liderar e executar testes de software complexos, utilizando ferramentas e métodos adequados para identificar defeitos e garantir que o produto final atenda aos requisitos e padrões de qualidade;
  • Treinar, capacitar e desenvolver a equipe de Analistas de Qualidade de Software em testes manuais e automatizados, novas ferramentas e metodologias ágeis, a fim de garantir a atualização contínua e a excelência técnica;
  • Analisar os resultados dos testes e documentar os defeitos encontrados, com detalhes e prioridade, para ajudar a equipe de desenvolvimento a fazer as correções;
  • Efetuar a revisão e realizar novos testes após as correções para verificar se os defeitos apontados foram corrigidos e se não afetou outra parte do sistema;
  • Elaborar testes automatizados de software, cobrindo desde testes unitários até testes de integração e ponta a ponta, criando scripts que simulam interações com a aplicação, sem a necessidade de intervenção manual, com o objetivo de detectar de forma rápida e eficiente regressões e erros, contribuindo para uma entrega mais rápida e ágil do software;
  • Elaborar manuais do usuário claros e organizados para fornecer as informações necessárias aos usuários;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e inovações em testes de software, incluindo ferramentas, metodologias e padrões, para aplicar as melhores práticas.

O que a YouX espera de você?

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e similares;
  • Experiência mínima de 04 anos com testes manuais (Aplicando testes regressivos, exploratórios, usabilidade, integração e performance e Planejamento dos testes, escritas em BDD (gherkin));
  • Experiência com teste automatizado;
  • Conhecimento sólido dos métodos, técnicas e processos aplicados no desenvolvimento dos trabalhos, incluindo o planejamento e estratégias de testes, criação de cenários e execução de testes;
  • Conhecimento sólido com Postman: para testes de API; Cypress, Robot Framework, Selenium: para automação de testes (web, desktop e mobile);
  • Conhecimento sólido de desenvolvimento de softwares e das linguagens de programação (Cypress + Javascript; Robot Framework + Python; Selenium + Python);
  • Conhecimento intermediário de metodologias ágeis;
  • Liderança de pessoas e comunicação assertiva;
  • Dedicação, responsabilidade e vontade de aprender e se adaptar rapidamente a novas tecnologias;
  • Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente em equipe e trazer ideias criativas para o time;
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas e busca por soluções inovadoras;
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade e a entrega de resultados.

Benefícios

  • Cuidado para sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash multibenefícios personalizados: VA e VR para ajudar na sua alimentação;

  • Develop robust, test‑driven ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL in Airflow to transform raw microservice data into gold‑standard domain datasets.
  • Champion data governance practices, ensuring models and transformations enforce company data concepts and quality standards.

  • Live the mission by inspiring and empowering others, fostering a supportive environment where wellbeing and work‑life wellness are prioritized.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced Data and/or Analytics Engineer with a proven track record of managing complex data projects and influencing technical direction.

  • Prior involvement in organizational transformation toward Shift Left or Data Mesh approaches is a plus.

Competencies Required

  • Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Designing and optimizing Data Warehouse or Lakehouse data models.
  • Understanding of distributed query engines and query optimization.
  • Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
  • Advanced data governance and quality checks (e.g., Great Expectations).
  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration.
  • Roadmap, task management, and prioritization.
  • Familiarity with data cataloging and discovery tools such as OpenMetadata.
  • Experience with a Shift Left or Data Mesh approach accelerates success.

What We Offer You
