title: Visual Designer
description:
Overview

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, inquietas, com coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira. Valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada. Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências. Na Kunumi, o design é a forma como traduzimos complexidade em sentido; ele nos ajuda a ver (e fazer os outros verem) aquilo que ainda está sendo imaginado. Procuramos uma pessoa que compreenda o design não apenas como forma ou estética, mas como uma maneira de pensar, comunicar e provocar. Alguém capaz de transformar conceitos abstratos, dados e ideias em narrativas visuais que inspirem entendimento e emoção, revelando o que há de mais humano na tecnologia que criamos. Este papel é essencial para dar corpo, cor e ritmo às histórias que contamos sobre quem somos e o impacto que queremos gerar. Do design gráfico ao digital, da apresentação à visualização de dados, o trabalho dessa pessoa tocará diretamente a forma como a Kunumi se expressa, para dentro e para fora.

Responsabilidades

  • Traduzir ideias complexas em expressões visuais claras, inspiradoras e consistentes com a identidade da Kunumi.
  • Criar apresentações estratégicas e narrativas visuais que unam estética, clareza e propósito.
  • Produzir materiais gráficos e digitais para diferentes contextos (internos e externos), com foco em storytelling.
  • Desenvolver infográficos, visualizações de dados e motion graphics, conectando informação, design e emoção.
  • Garantir coerência e evolução contínua da identidade visual, cuidando de como ela se manifesta em cada ponto de contato.
  • Colaborar com áreas diversas (Design, Comunicação, Produto, Liderança) para construir narrativas visuais que reforcem a visão e a cultura Kunumi.

O que é esperado de você

  • Experiência sólida em design gráfico, visual design e design para apresentações, infografia e storytelling.
  • Domínio técnico em Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Google Suíte, principalmente plataformas de apresentação como Google Slides, PowerPoint, Keynote, etc.
  • Habilidade em utilizar IA generativa para criar imagens e conteúdos.
  • Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, com alta qualidade e atenção a prazos.
  • Capacidade de síntese e pensamento visual, transformar conceitos complexos em mensagens visuais claras.
  • Curiosidade e repertório estético, com olhar apurado para composição, tipografia, ritmo e cor.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com pessoas de diferentes áreas e formações.
  • Capacidade de equilibrar criação e execução, saber quando ousar e quando simplificar.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência prática com infografia e visualização de dados.
  • Experiência com edição de vídeo e motion design.
  • Noções básicas de UiUx design, usabilidade, pesquisa e design thinking.
  • Vivência em ambientes de inovação, ciência de dados ou tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento de inglês que permita leitura e referência de materiais visuais internacionais.

Sobre a Kunumi

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes. Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto. Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

Benefícios

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto;
  • Trabalho em ambiente remoto com horário flexível;
  • Suporte home-office (ajuda de custo, cadeira, headphones, laptop, entre outros);
  • Plano de saúde premium e dental para você e seus dependentes, sem mensalidade;
  • Alimentação (cartão flexível);
  • Licença parental estendida
  • Assistência a Filhos;
  • Auxílio para Filhos(as) com Deficiência;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programas de promoção à Saúde - mental, física e emocional
  • Parceria Wellhub - Plano Gold gratuito
  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano
  • Kunumi Day mensal - Toda segunda sexta-feira do mês ficamos off

Sobre o processo

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove a criatividade e acelera resultados positivos, portanto, consideramos todos os candidatos não somente pela qualificação técnica, mas também como nos complementa como grupo. Conheça a nossa Política de Tratamento de Dados de Candidatos.

title: Partner Account Manager - Public Sector
description:
Overview

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, Equipment Monitoring, and Site Visibility. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This role will join Samsara’s Global Partnerships team, which is responsible for building and activating our ecosystem of go-to-market partners across Insurance, co-sell, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Public Sector routes to market, and Fleet Management Companies.

You’ll be responsible for our Public Sector referral partners and tier 2 reseller partners - building scalable programs to drive business via Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner motions, sharing Samsara’s innovation with our partners, and helping to drive a differentiated presence in the market.

This is a great role for somebody looking to make an impact and influence the future of our Public Sector partnership strategy.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop key relationships and build scalable programs with our Public Sector distribution and resale partners to drive net new pipeline and accelerate sales outcomes
  • Work with Sales and other cross-functional partners within Samsara to identify opportunities that our partners can accelerate
  • Build a scaled Public Sector channel motion (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Play a role in shaping our Public Sector partnerships strategic roadmap
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5 years of experience in Public Sector partnerships or sales
  • Experience with scaled Public Sector channel motions (tier 1 / tier 2)
  • Experience building programs with a history of driving the Public Sector pipeline through partners
  • Kind and collaborative orientation, who is energized by working with a lot of different types of people from many teams
  • A builder mentality—you thrive in ambiguous environments and know how to create structure, process, and scale
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives simultaneously

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in B2B technology or within a B2B technology ecosystem
  • Experience working with Carahsoft
  • Experience with common Public Sector contract vehicles used to purchase IT/cloud and/or fleet management solutions

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. $78,926.75 — $132,650 USD

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Benefits

Full time employees receive a competitive total compensation package along with employee-led remote and flexible working, health benefits, and much, much more. Take a look at our Benefits site to learn more.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. About Purolabs

We\'re looking for a proactive and data-driven Growth Marketer who lives and breathes performance marketing and customer acquisition. This is not a brand marketing role - the focus is entirely on direct response: driving measurable customer acquisition, optimising funnels, and scaling campaigns profitably. You\'ll own the full growth strategy, working hands-on with paid acquisition, conversion optimisation, and customer retention. You should be the kind of person who obsesses over unit economics, loves testing new approaches, and gets genuinely excited when you crack a winning strategy that scales.

  • Conduct competitor analysis and market research to identify growth opportunities
  • Proactively flag issues, spot inconsistencies, and solve problems before they escalate
  • Think strategically about the big picture while maintaining attention to detail

Essential Experience

What We\'re Looking For

  • 2-3+ years of proven experience in direct response or growth marketing for DTC e-commerce brands

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with other emerging acquisition channels
  • Background in health, wellness, or supplements industry

Your Personality

  • Numbers-obsessed and data-driven - you make decisions based on metrics, not opinions
  • Highly detail-oriented with ability to spot incongruencies and think strategically

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and drives results independently

Why Join Us

  • Work with a product that genuinely improves people\'s wellbeing

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to modernize the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds, with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users in need of assistance. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT.

The Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels. We are predominantly Mac-focused and you should be proficient at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment and will own the onboarding experience for all new employees as well as the retrieval process for departing employees. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, and more. You will work with Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.). You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (Google Workspace, Okta, etc.) and document solutions, create help articles, and automate routine tasks. You will manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues through to completion. You will balance help desk tickets with project work (agile practices, Jira, sprints) and align your objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and help non-technical users without loss of patience.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • A mindset to provide a magical experience for others and a security-conscious approach (PGP awareness).
  • Solid networking fundamentals and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching) and methodical OSI-model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior use is helpful but certifications are not required.
  • Experience using GAM and command-line efficiencies.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress, adaptability and resilience; comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in handling confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have previously worked in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting from your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company through shared equity.
  • Remote work option up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A role with purpose and the removal of barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Inclusive, diverse, equal opportunity employment; confidentiality in accommodation requests.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is truly global, spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote-first environment. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. No unsolicited resumes accepted.

Arquiteto - Dados & Soluções | Grupo Autoglass

Descrição da vaga: Olá! :D Estamos em um momento de transformação e crescimento acelerado com a criação de diversos produtos digitais dentro da organização. Esses produtos não apenas consomem dados, mas também os geram, tornando essencial garantir que os dados sejam bem estruturados, integráveis, governáveis e utilizáveis no ambiente analítico da empresa.

Hoje já contamos com arquitetos de software responsáveis pela arquitetura das aplicações, mas identificamos a necessidade de contar com uma figura dedicada à arquitetura de dados, para garantir uma visão unificada e estratégica sobre os dados gerados, consumidos e armazenados em nossos sistemas e plataformas analíticas.

Essa pessoa atuará de forma transversal com as equipes de engenharia de dados, ciência de dados, governança de dados e arquitetura de software.

Cultura da equipe

  • Transparência: promovemos a transparência em nossas ações e processos, garantindo que todos os stakeholders tenham acesso à informação necessária para tomara decisões.
  • Colaboração: trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, incentivando o compartilhamento de conhecimentos e experiências para apoiar nas entregas de valor do time.
  • Inovação: estamos em busca constante por melhorias que envolvam os processos de gestão de dados da empresa, com o objetivo de habilitar um uso sustentável e seguro.
  • Responsabilidade: assumimos a responsabilidade por cada iniciativa promovida pela equipe, assegurando que as entregas propostas serão de valor para a evolução do time e do negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados corporativa, garantindo escalabilidade, performance, segurança e integridade dos dados.
  • Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos de software para alinhar os modelos de dados das aplicações às necessidades analíticas e regulatórias da empresa.
  • Definir padrões e boas práticas para modelagem de dados (OLTP e OLAP), integração de dados e documentação técnica.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização do ecossistema de dados, como data mesh, data lakehouse, event streaming e outros.
  • Apoiar os times de engenharia de dados na definição de pipelines, ingestão e transformação de dados, bem como em estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e catalogação.
  • Ser referência técnica em decisões estratégicas relacionadas a arquitetura de dados e integração entre domínios de negócio.
  • Atuar nas squads de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais trazendo uma visão sobre a arquitetura de dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólido conhecimento em arquiteturas de dados como data lakehouse, data warehouse etc.
  • Conhecimento em implementação de streaming de dados, como Apache Kafka.
  • Conhecimento na nuvem da AWS.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados.
  • Experiência com CI/CD.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Habilidade de organização e planejamento.

Valorizamos se você tiver:

  • Noções de uso de frameworks de governança de dados (ex.: DAMA-DMBOK, DMM).
  • Experiência com ferramenta de visualização de dados (ex.: Tableau).
  • Conhecimento em SQL.
  • Experiência com Grafana e Kibana.

Informações adicionais

O que a Autoglass proporciona?

  • Pra cuidar da sua saúde física e mental:

Plano de saúde Unimed e Plano odontológico Bradesco, extensivos a seus dependentes; Atendimento psicológico e nutricional; Seguro de vida; Programa da Gestante com licença maternidade estendida; Espaço Cuidar - Salão de beleza; Wellhub (desconto em academias); na Autoglass você recebe massagem relaxante no posto de trabalho.

Vale transporte; Vale Refeição e Alimentação (Cartão Ifood Benefícios); Descontos em creches e escolas para os papais e mamães; Descontos em Instituições de Ensino; Café da manhã e da tarde; Oportunidade de trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários com um time incrível e acolhedor; Oportunidades Home Office; Trabalho de modo confortável! Caso necessário, enviaremos toda mobília para equipar o seu ambiente Home Office; Programa Indica Tech - bônus por indicar novos talentos para fazerem parte do time; Programa Logoff - Saia 2h mais cedo na sexta ou entre 2h mais tarde na segunda e aproveite um fim de semana estendido (Conforme normas da empresa).

Para desenvolver sua carreira:

No Grupo Autoglass, você encontrará oportunidade de crescimento e uma cultura de inovação e melhoria contínua muito forte.

description:
Creative Strategist for UK E-Commerce Brand

Creative Strategist UK E-Commerce Brand

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM 5:00 PM UK GMT (minimum 4 hours overlap)

Contract Type: Independent contractor

Language: English only

About Purolabs

Purolabs is a fast-growing DTC supplements brand based in the UK with over 350,000 happy customers. We create clean, science-backed supplements that actually work – no fillers, no nasties, just real results. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, our UK-made products are trusted by health‑conscious people who refuse to compromise on quality.

The Role

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes performance marketing and creative. You’re equal parts strategic thinker and compelling copywriter – someone who owns the creative vision behind our paid social campaigns while writing the scripts, briefs, and copy that bring them to life. It’s about understanding customer pain points, crafting messages that resonate, and driving real growth through performance‑focused creative that converts. You should obsess over hook rates, study competitor ads for fun, and get genuinely excited when you crack a winning angle.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop end‑to‑end creative strategies aligned with customer acquisition targets
  • Conduct competitor analysis and trend research to keep our creative cutting‑edge
  • Map out creative testing roadmaps and campaign calendars
  • Write compelling direct‑response copy, UGC scripts, and ad copy for Meta and TikTok
  • Craft hooks, CTAs, and messaging that convert browsers into buyers
  • Develop copy for landing pages, email campaigns, and marketing materials
  • Translate complex supplement science into clear, benefit‑driven messaging
  • Create detailed creative briefs for designers and video editors
  • Collaborate with graphic designers and marketing team
  • Manage the creative production pipeline from ideation to launch
  • Analyse creative performance metrics including CTR, CPA, hook rate, conversion rate, and ROAS
  • Implement A/B testing and rapid iteration based on data insights
  • Present weekly performance reports with actionable recommendations

Essential Experience

  • 2+ years of proven experience in creative strategy and copywriting for DTC brands
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating successful paid social campaigns with measurable results
  • Experience writing scripts for UGC creators, Meta ads, and TikTok ads
  • Deep understanding of marketing psychology, emotional triggers, and conversion copywriting
  • Data‑driven mindset with ability to turn metrics into actionable creative insights
  • Exceptional communication skills and obsessive attention to detail
  • Expert‑level copywriting for performance marketing
  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager
  • Available during UK working hours (9am‑5pm GMT) with minimum 4‑hour overlap daily
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) – all application materials must be in English

Bonus Points

  • Experience with competitor research tools (Motion, Foreplay, MagicBrief)
  • Background in health, wellness, or supplements industry
  • Understanding of ASA regulations and health claims compliance
  • Experience directing on‑camera talent or creators

Your Personality

  • You live and breathe performance marketing – truly obsessed with what makes ads work
  • Passionate about creative strategy and social trends
  • Excellent communicator who values clarity and over‑communication
  • Solutions‑oriented with high emotional intelligence
  • Detail‑oriented and triple‑checks everything
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and thrives in fast‑paced environments

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote with flexibility during UK hours
  • Competitive salary and paid time off (including UK bank holidays)
  • Real ownership over creative strategy and direction
  • Training opportunities and quarterly growth reviews
  • Work on campaigns that genuinely improve people’s wellbeing
  • Join a fast‑growing brand with proven product‑market fit and loyal customers

How to Apply

Please submit your application via LinkedIn including:

title: Data Engineer
description:
A Avra é uma plataforma de inteligência de dados deep tech, que traduz a complexidade das pequenas e médias empresas em decisões estratégicas para grandes corporações.

Desenvolvemos nossos próprios modelos fundamentais do zero — sem depender de soluções de terceiros — para entregar insights inovadores que impulsionam grandes bancos e fintechs em toda a América Latina.

Fundada em 2024 por Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) e Viviane Meister , a Avra reúne talentos, com o propósito de fazer IA de verdade e gerar impacto real.

Sobre a Vaga

Na Avra, estamos construindo nossa plataforma de dados do zero — uma base confiável e escalável que sustenta nossos produtos e os modelos de IA que desenvolvemos.

Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior , você será peça-chave na concepção, evolução e governança dessa infraestrutura, garantindo que os dados fluam de forma segura, rastreável e de alta qualidade entre sistemas e times.

Nosso desafio vai muito além de ingestão e transformação: estamos criando um ecossistema de dados robusto, que atende múltiplos consumidores — de times de produto a research — cada um com diferentes níveis de performance, experimentação e governança.

Você vai ajudar a tomar decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo, sem perder o foco em entregar soluções táticas que geram valor imediato.

Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura Lakehouse: Projetar e gerenciar estruturas escaláveis baseadas em Apache Iceberg nos ambientes AWS e GCP, com versionamento, time travel e alto desempenho analítico.
  • Engenharia de Pipelines: Construir e manter pipelines batch e streaming usando Spark, Ray e Dagster.
  • Governança de Dados: Definir e aplicar padrões de qualidade, segurança, linhagem e compliance, assegurando confiabilidade e contexto em todo o ciclo de vida dos dados.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Utilizar Terraform e CI/CD para versionar e implantar toda a stack de dados — de permissões e buckets a orquestrações e componentes de computação.
  • Arquitetura e Data Warehouse: Projetar arquiteturas de dados e DW multi-cloud (AWS e GCP), garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e otimização de custo.
  • Gestão de Grafos: Manter e evoluir o grafo heterogêneo de relacionamentos que alimenta nossos modelos de IA.
  • Colaboração Técnica: Trabalhar junto a engenheiros, cientistas de dados e stakeholders técnicos para alinhar a estratégia de dados às metas da Avra.

Você se destaca se...

  • Tem domínio em Python e Spark e gosta de resolver problemas complexos em grande escala.
  • Já construiu ou manteve arquiteturas lakehouse com Apache Iceberg ou Delta Lake.
  • Tem experiência com Dagster (ou ferramentas equivalentes) para orquestração de pipelines.
  • Entende profundamente ambientes multi-cloud (AWS e GCP) e sabe tirar o máximo proveito de ambos.
  • Já implementou práticas sólidas de governança, observabilidade e linhagem de dados.
  • Possui experiência com arquitetura de dados e Data Warehouses modernos, equilibrando performance e custo.
  • É uma pessoa proativa, analítica e com mentalidade de produto, que se preocupa em entregar dados úteis, acessíveis e confiáveis.
  • Gosta de trabalhar em um ambiente de inovação, colaboração e velocidade, típico de startups deep tech.

Requisitos

  • Experiência: +5 anos em Engenharia de Dados, com histórico de criação e manutenção de arquiteturas escaláveis.
  • Stack Principal: Python, Spark, Ray, Dagster, Iceberg, Terraform, AWS (S3, IAM, Glue, Kinesis) e GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Dataflow, GKE).
  • Domínios Técnicos: Modelagem de dados, pipelines de ETL, governança, linhagem e processamento em tempo real.
  • Metodologias: CI/CD, versionamento de infraestrutura e boas práticas modernas de engenharia de software.
  • Habilidades Interpessoais: Boa comunicação, senso de dono e capacidade de alinhar decisões técnicas à estratégia do produto.

Por que se juntar à Avra?

  • Compensação Competitiva: Salário atrativo, participação acionária e total transparência na estrutura de remuneração.

title: Database Administrator - SQL Server | Remote
description:
Overview

Como Administrador(a) de Banco de Dados Sênior (DBA), com especialidade em SQL Server, você gerenciará e manterá o sistema de banco de dados SQL Server, garantindo a integridade dos dados, performance e segurança. Lidera iniciativas complexas, orienta DBAs mais juniores e atua como referência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar e manter instâncias e bancos de dados SQL Server (versões 2012 a 2022).
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Recovery (Full, Differential, Transaction log, Point-in-time recovery).
  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.
  • Configurar e gerenciar a Auditoria do SQL Server para fins de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de performance de queries complexas, analisando planos de execução, utilizando Query Store e definindo estratégias de indexação.
  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.
  • Realizar tuning de I/O, CPU e Memória para otimizar a performance do SQL Server.
  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.
  • Desenvolver scripts em PowerShell para automação de tarefas administrativas e de manutenção.
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas de manutenção e criação de alertas.
  • Configurar, gerenciar e analisar logs de auditoria e monitoramento de atividades no SQL Server.
  • Implementar e gerenciar a automação de deployments de banco de dados (ex: Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate).
  • Integrar o gerenciamento de código de banco de dados com sistemas de controle de versão (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).
  • Integrar e manter deployments de banco de dados em pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos de banco de dados.
  • Orientar DBAs de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre o ambiente de banco de dados.

Requisitos básicos

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência consolidada (8+ anos) em administração de banco de dados, com especialidade em SQL Server.
  • Profundo conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção do SQL Server (versões 2012, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Experiência prática com estratégias de Backup e Recovery
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança SQL Server
  • Experiência com requisitos de conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Domínio de Performance Tuning
  • Experiência com ferramentas de diagnóstico de performance: SQL Profiler, Extended Events, DMVs.
  • Conhecimento em tuning de I/O, CPU, Memória e otimização de TempDB.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting de Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.

  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.

title: Manager, Paid Search
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands‑on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Mexico

What you’ll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

  • Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.

  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 7+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 5+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative.

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert.

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results.

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM).

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Generous Quarterly Bonuses: Your productivity directly translates to your compensation. We offer a competitive quarterly bonus structure that is both substantial and customized to your role, ensuring your hard work is consistently and generously rewarded.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Pontos a mais se você possui

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;

  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;

E mais

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive. Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir. Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga e dados que possam ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. Não teremos acesso a dados fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade é identificação, comunicação e análise das candidatas.

description:
Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Focusing on offshore and onshore logistics operations, this position will plan, coordinate, and execute the movement of materials, equipment, and personnel. The role will lead the logistics team and oversee all logistics aspects, including vessel, helicopter, and shorebase contracts and monitoring, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations, timely and cost-effective deliveries, optimized cargo planning, and accurate logistics documentation and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and execute logistics operations for the transportation of materials, equipment, and personnel between onshore bases, warehouses, ports, and offshore units.
  • Manage and oversee vessel contracts, ensuring effective day-to-day coordination, performance monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Manage and oversee helicopter contracts, ensuring safe and timely operations in line with company requirements.
  • Manage and oversee shorebase contracts, monitoring performance and ensuring service quality and compliance.
  • Lead the logistics team and all logistics activities, driving efficiency, cost optimization, and alignment with project and operational needs.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, customs regulations, import/export legislation, and health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.

  • Follow up on material requisitions, dispatches, returns, and cargo tracking using ERP systems and logistics software.

  • Ensure proper packaging, labeling, and preservation of materials in accordance with applicable standards and offshore requirements.
  • Control documentation for hazardous materials (IMO/ADR/IATA) and ensure safe transport in compliance with regulations.
  • Track inventory movements between locations and support warehouse activities when required.
  • Maintain accurate records of all shipments, freight costs, delays, and delivery KPIs.
  • Support the preparation of logistics procedures, manuals, and compliance reports.
  • Assist in contractor performance evaluation and cost control initiatives within the logistics function.
  • Participate in daily/weekly operations meetings to align logistics activities with planning and operational needs.
  • Respond to operational challenges and emergencies, proposing mitigation measures and alternative logistics solutions.
  • Coordinate crew change logistics when required, including travel, immigration, and accommodation arrangements.
  • Provide logistics support for regulatory inspections or audits related to customs, cargo, and HSE.

Education

  • Technical or university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

  • Experience in logistics coordination, preferably in oil & gas.
  • Familiarity with freight forwarding, customs clearance, and offshore logistics operations.

title: Ux Designer
description:
Join to apply for the Ux Designer role at Memory Ware

At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades.

We're looking for a UX Designer who's excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs. As a UX Designer on our team, you'll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat and exploration.

We're not just looking for someone to make interfaces clean and usable, we want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience.

You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player-first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game genre-aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player-first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system-heavy or narrative-rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing for console or controller-first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply:

Send your e‑mail to "******" with a subject like "UX Designer – Your Name". Include your resume, portfolio, and any details about yourself that you'd like to share.

About Memory Ware: Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born on **** to sustainably create video games designed with a player‑first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players. We are a self‑funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you're eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you'll feel right at home with us.
